verdict.rationale: Chronicle's docs say you attach scorers to tasks, and code-based checks verify concrete outputs or recorded changes alongside LLM-judge scorers (docs-1). Scorers return a 0–1 value with configurable pass thresholds (docs-4), and they are versioned and pinned to runs within task suites (docs-11, docs-13). missing for 10: detailed docs on the scorer-authoring API, which languages scorers can be written in, examples of custom aggregate metrics beyond per-check scores, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
